_comment: Routing data for the small local-testing tenant. Deliberately minimal. A group no longer carries its own no_answer: what happens when nobody picks up belongs to whatever rang the group.
_comment_extensions: Bare destinations are sugar for a one-node dial. 600 used to be the AI receptionist; it is now the engineering group, which is what callers dialing it actually wanted.
_comment_dids: Step TWO for an inbound call: what HAPPENS to a call to this number. Step one — which tenant owns it — already happened in resources/config/routes.json, which is why the same number appears in both files answering different questions. A number routed here by step one but absent from this map is still OUR call; it simply matches nothing and reaches the operator.
